hook: For Audible, Stephen Fry recorded the entire canon of 60 original Sherlock Holmes stories.

sections.voiceover: For Audible, Stephen Fry recorded the entire canon of 60 original Sherlock Holmes stories.
sections.visual_cue: Archival audio recording setup overlaid with title text detailing the 60 original stories catalog.
b_roll: Historical manuscript pages of Sherlock Holmes stories

sections.voiceover: Between 1887 and 1927, Arthur Conan Doyle penned the 60 original stories. Previously, Fry portrayed the character Mycroft Holmes in the film A Game of Shadows. What variations did the Conan Doyle Estate authorize?
sections.visual_cue: Timeline display spanning from 1887 to 1927 showing original publishing dates alongside film credit stills.
b_roll: First edition publication covers from 1887 to 1927

sections.voiceover: But the Conan Doyle Estate authorized variations sending the pair against the Nazis.
sections.visual_cue: Archival document records highlighting estate authorizations for mid-century literary variations.

sections.voiceover: The Conan Doyle Estate also authorized variations involving Adrian Conan Doyle and John. From 2014 to 2023, the estate authorized further adaptations.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic timeline mapping authorization dates from 2014 to 2023 leading into digital audio studio display.
b_roll: Modern digital audio master tape reel

sections.voiceover: Doyle finished writing the 60 original stories in 1927.
sections.visual_cue: Final historical date display focusing on 1927 as the completion of the original written canon.
b_roll: Close-up of final printed page date 1927
